theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy ranks 2 with eligibility intact, the strongest breadth of any top-3 theme (0.636 vs AI Infra 0.125 and Cybersecurity 0.60), and a durable Hurst 'mixed' tag that is not failing trend. Its crowding z=0.93 is high but below the crowded flag, so this reads as broad participation rather than froth. In a narrowing-rotation regime with high unscheduled macro surprise share, energy as a supply/inflation-adjacent theme offers the cleanest trend-gate-passing continuation among top themes.
evidence: absolute_trend_gate validated as drawdown-control edge, gate_helps=true
theses.dissent: High crowding z (0.93) and a Hurst 'mixed' (not 'trend') tag mean the theme may already be well-owned and choppy; the strongest energy move may have occurred, leaving range-bound chop.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is rank 3 and eligible with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, but it carries crowding_z 1.61 — already flagged crowded=true — on breadth of only 0.60. Under the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade, but combined with the AI Infrastructure leader not being crowded and energy showing broader participation, there is no reason to prefer cybersecurity over the top-two themes at this moment.
theses.dissent: A clean trend with strong momentum could persist despite crowding; crowding is not a timing tool and this theme could keep ripping in a security-spending supercycle.
